title: Temperature, top-k and top-p sampling
summary: Scale logits by temperature, keep the top k or the top p mass, renormalize, and draw one token with a seeded rng.

mutants.in_place_filter: Writes minus infinity into the caller's logits in top_k_filter.
mutants.sample_ignores_temperature: Calls sampling_probs without the temperature in sample, so draws use temperature 1.
mutants.temperature_after_filters: Divides by the temperature after the filters, so top-p cuts the distribution at temperature 1.
mutants.top_k_ties_high_index: Sorts with argsort and reverses the result, so ties keep the higher index.
mutants.top_p_drops_crossing: Drops the token that makes the cumulative sum reach p, and keeps at least one token.
mutants.top_p_vocab_order: Takes the cumulative sum in vocabulary order, not in order of probability.
